description: When 1Password CLI is missing, the error only says how to install it. A user with the 1Password app but no `op` gets no hint that clipboard-and-confirm or a file also work.
expected: Error ends with: or run `agent-drive credentials export --to clipboard` (paste into 1Password) or `--to <path>`
actual: The 1Password CLI (`op`) is not installed. Nothing was exported. Install the 1Password CLI (...) then run this again.
suggested_fix: Append the clipboard and file alternatives to the op-not-installed / not-signed-in errors.

description: File backup success line does not say where the file was written or that it must stay out of repos and synced folders.
expected: Backed up credentials for 1 drive(s) to <absolute path> (file)
suggested_fix: Print the absolute path and one safety sentence.

description: Wording of the third backup route differs by surface: help says 'outside the repo', hint/docs say 'outside the sandbox'.
actual: help: 'a file outside the repo'; BACKUP_HINT: 'a file outside the sandbox, on a path that survives it'
evidence: CLI help vs login hint vs clipboard error
